login_intro: Sign in with your Home Assistant account to see your Garmin data.
login_error_network: Home Assistant could not be reached, or it does not allow this app's address. Check the app options and the reverse proxy.
banner_key_invalid: Garmin rejected your key. Syncing is paused until you enter a new one.
banner_key_expired: Your Garmin key has expired. Enter a new one to continue syncing.
banner_key_expiring: Your Garmin key expires in {days} day(s).
onboarding_step1: Open Garmin Connect in a browser and create a Personal API key under Settings.
onboarding_step2: Copy the key (it is shown only once).
onboarding_step3: Paste it in the settings here. The app checks it and starts loading your history, newest first.
chart_pmc_label: Fitness, fatigue and form over time
form_fresh: Form is high: you are rested, or detraining.
form_optimal: Form is negative: a productive training load.
form_overreach: Form is very negative: high fatigue, watch for overreaching.
dashboard_health_hint: In brackets: change against the 28 days before.
detail_fit_pending: The detailed data of this activity is still loading.
detail_fit_missing: No detailed file is available for this activity; only the summary is shown.
detail_hr_cleaned: Max HR cleaned: {clean} bpm (raw {raw} bpm), {seconds} s of heart-rate measurement errors removed.
detail_legs_hint: Load counts per leg; the session as a whole is not counted twice in the analyses.
detail_parent_link: Part of a multisport session: go to the whole session
zones_from_garmin: From Garmin's own zone times (their zone limits).
trends_pmc_hint: Fitness (CTL) is the 42-day load average, fatigue (ATL) the 7-day one, form (TSB) is yesterday's fitness minus fatigue.
trends_best_hint: Over the last 12 months, taken from Garmin's per-activity records.
key_help: Create the key in Garmin Connect under Settings, Personal API. It is checked immediately, stored encrypted and never shown again.
key_link: Open Garmin Connect: Personal API key
key_expires_input: Expiry date of the key (optional, for the reminder)
key_saved: Key accepted. The first sync has started.
key_rejected: Garmin did not accept this key.
key_garmin_unavailable: Garmin could not be reached. Try again later.
key_invalid_input: The key or the date is not valid.
key_remove_body: Syncing stops. The data already stored stays until you delete it.
sync_hint: New data is fetched when the app opens and at the configured interval. The history is loaded newest first and can take a while.
athlete_help: Imported from Garmin where available. Your own values are kept with a valid-from date, so past training stress is not recalculated with today's thresholds.
athlete_pace_invalid: Enter the pace as minutes:seconds, for example 5:00.
data_help: Deleting removes all synced activities, files and health data of your account from this app. Your Garmin key stays; Garmin is not changed.
data_delete_body: All synced activities, FIT files, health data and thresholds are removed. This cannot be undone. The next sync loads everything again.
about_text: Garmin Insights mirrors your Garmin data locally. Nothing leaves your Home Assistant except requests to Garmin and map tiles.
mcp_help: The MCP server lets any AI assistant or MCP client analyse your training and health data in detail. It only ever sees your own data and signs in through Home Assistant (OAuth).
mcp_generic: Any other MCP client: add a remote server with this address, transport Streamable HTTP, and sign in with Home Assistant when the client opens the login.
mcp_claude_ai: Example claude.ai: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste the address.
mcp_claude_code: Example Claude Code: run this command, then type /mcp and sign in.
mcp_tools: Available: {tools}. All read-only except trigger_sync, which starts a sync.
mcp_unavailable: The MCP server needs the app options ha_external_url and app_external_url, plus a reverse proxy with HTTPS in front of port 8100. Set them in the app configuration and restart.
cs_help: Garmin sometimes files activities differently from how you do them (e.g. dragon boat as SUP). Create your own sports and assign activities by hand. Calculations still follow the Garmin type; the custom sport drives filtering and grouping.
cs_delete_body: "{name}" will be deleted. Assigned activities keep their Garmin type.
cs_type_mismatch: This sport does not fit the activity's type.
